summary: BioCardia, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a press release disclosing a $4.4 million at-the-market (ATM) offering of 3,509,604 shares at an average price of $1.279 per share, sold on June 5, 2026, under an agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co. No warrants were issued. This capital raise is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation transaction. The proceeds are intended to extend cash runway into Q1 2027. The filing is a routine current report for an ATM takedown, with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation triggers. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond standard ATM terms are mentioned.
